== Title ==
<span lang="ja">彼はまだ戻っていません</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに、自分の屋外の惑星位置に単独でいる任意のキャラクターを目標とする。ただしドッキング・ベイは除く。運命数を引く。運命数＋3＞能力値なら目標は行方不明になる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「レイア姫がルーク様のことを心配しておられます。どこに居られるのか御存じないそうで。私も存じません。誰も知っておられないようなのです」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — He Hasn't Come Back Yet.

'''Lore''' — Princess Leia is worried about Master Luke. She does not know where he is. I do not know either. Nobody knows where he is.

'''Game text''' — During your control phase, target any character alone at your exterior planet location. Docking bays are excluded. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 exceeds ability, the target becomes missing.

Lore is one polite quote, not three speakers. Game text uses 位置 for site and 行方不明 for missing. The docking-bay exception is a separate ただし sentence.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-hehasntcomebackyet.gif|Original English face]], [[He Hasn't Come Back Yet]].</ref>
